framework_reference: Morse JM, Morse RM, Tylko SJ. Development of a scale to identify the fall-prone patient. Can J Aging. 1989;8(4):366-377.
specified_before: any v2 execution on real data; before the v1 full-corpus run; before Raw/ mirror completion (amendment A7)
changes_from_v1: D1: gait duration construct is gait_temporal_control.stance_duration_ms (t_foot_up -> t_end), not stability_duration_ms (t_stable -> t_break). CoP EMUs keep the stable window.
D3: gait_type reclassified derivable -> partial; single-leg stance is related evidence for the Morse gait item, not the ambulation observation the item names.
D4: thresholds unchanged (10000 / 5000 ms; sway 250 / 600 mm^2), now carried in the map's rule block so the map bytes define the rule.

D4a: protocol censoring. A duration threshold the acquisition protocol did not permit to be observed yields protocol_censored, not a participant label. Ceiling comes from the fixture's acquisition_protocol (TRLG* = 20000 ms from README; MNTR* = null, unpublished).
D2 / D2a: capture-level best_of_attempts aggregation declared here, evaluable only if every attempt yields the EMU field and no attempt windows overlap.
All other criteria: byte-identical text to v1.

history_of_falling.label: History of falling
history_of_falling.non_evaluable_reason: Requires self-report or medical-record evidence external to OLST biomechanics.

secondary_diagnosis.label: Secondary diagnosis
secondary_diagnosis.non_evaluable_reason: Requires clinical record evidence external to OLST biomechanics.

ambulatory_aids.label: Ambulatory aids
ambulatory_aids.partial_reason: Gait pattern from MoCap event labels is a proxy for aid use, not definitive — radar/MoCap cannot distinguish a cane from a walker, and absence of an aid in capture does not imply absence in daily life.

iv_therapy.label: IV therapy / heparin lock
iv_therapy.non_evaluable_reason: Requires clinical record evidence external to OLST biomechanics.

gait_type.label: Gait type (normal / weak / impaired)
gait_type.partial_reason: The Morse gait item is an observation of ambulation (posture, step length, use of furniture for support). Single-leg stance duration and CoP sway are related balance evidence, not that observation; the mapping is a proxy and is declared as such.
gait_type.derivation_summary: Stance duration (gait_temporal_control.stance_duration_ms, foot-lift to foot-touchdown) combined with CoP sway over the stable sub-window (postural_stability_index.sway_area_mm2) maps to Morse gait categories under the rule block below, subject to protocol censoring.

semantics.protocol_censored: acquisition_protocol.observation_ceiling_ms is null or below a duration threshold the label would need; the measured stance_duration_ms is reported in detail and no duration label is asserted. The sway bound is not censored by the stance ceiling.

gait_type.thresholds_note: Identical numeric values to v1 (D4, no tuning). Moved from the harness constant table into the map so a threshold change is a map-bytes change (new criterion_map_id), never a silent harness edit.

reference_norms.note: Age-stratified single-leg-stance norms are reference metadata only; no rule in this map reads them. Numeric values are transcribed in the manuscript from the sources, not embedded here, so that a transcription correction does not re-version the map.
sources: Springer BA, Marin R, Cyhan T, Roberts H, Gill NW. Normative values for the unipedal stance test with eyes open and closed. J Geriatr Phys Ther. 2007;30(1):8-15.
Bohannon RW. Single limb stance times: a descriptive meta-analysis of data from individuals at least 60 years of age. Top Geriatr Rehabil. 2006;22(1):70-77.

mental_status.label: Mental status (oriented / forgets limitations)
mental_status.non_evaluable_reason: Requires cognitive assessment evidence external to OLST biomechanics. Inferring from gait variability would collapse the epistemic boundary between measurement and inference; the system explicitly refuses.

aggregation.note: OLST clinical convention records the best of several attempts. The aggregate is computed by olst_capture_aggregate.py from per-attempt runs, never by merging fixtures. Sway is per-attempt and does not enter the aggregate label; per-attempt evaluations are listed beside the aggregate. Non-evaluable when any attempt lacks the field (reason names the attempt) or any two attempt windows overlap (release 1.0: 47_TRLGL_V4).

summary.note: 4 of 6 Morse criteria are structurally non-evaluable from OLST biomechanics; the remaining 2 are partial. v2 adds a third kind of evidence insufficiency to the two already declared (modality cannot observe; framework asks a different question): the acquisition protocol did not permit the threshold to be observed.
